collectionSelection: 24 lowest SHA256('tabtopitch-cohort-v1:' + source filename); no outcome access
cardSelection: SHA256('tabtopitch-card-v1:' + collection filename + ':' + card_id) integer mod 4 == 0; all rows of selected cards
cutoff: 70th percentile timestamp among eligible non-heldout collection rows, computed without outcomes
eligibility: Valid binary self-rating, prior observation of the card in this file, strictly increasing card time, at least 1 elapsed day; exact duplicate rows dropped
target: Anki self-rated recall: review_rating > 1, validated against upstream y; not externally graded accuracy
features: Earlier card reviews only: lag, prior exposure, prior lapses, smoothed prior correctness, prior rating, previous lag. Current grade/y never enter features.
evaluation: Temporal: post-cutoff reviews from fitting collections. Heldout: post-cutoff reviews from collections never fitted. Earlier outcomes remain available as later history, without parameter refitting.
metrics: paired collection-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals for Brier and log-loss differences
scope: Real public flashcard review data; proxy methodology research only. Not a replication of the upstream benchmark. Not evidence of guitar recall, verified answer accuracy, improved teaching, or causality.
stopRules: Missing selected source file or checksum mismatch
Empty split or missing target class
privacy: Local raw numeric review records only. Cloud publication allowlist: aggregate report, coefficients, metadata and checksums. No rows, timestamps, collection IDs, card IDs, or histories uploaded.
